name: game-arena
description: Real-time multiplayer game arena: React client, Express + Socket.IO server, shared packages

scripts.build: yarn build:shared && yarn workspace @arena/client build && yarn workspace @arena/server build
scripts.lint: yarn workspace @arena/shared lint && yarn workspace @arena/client lint && yarn workspace @arena/server lint
scripts.typecheck: yarn build:shared && yarn workspace @arena/shared typecheck && yarn workspace @arena/client typecheck && yarn workspace @arena/server typecheck
scripts.test: yarn workspace @arena/shared test && yarn workspace @arena/client test && yarn workspace @arena/server test
scripts.test:coverage: yarn workspace @arena/shared test:coverage && yarn workspace @arena/client test:coverage && yarn workspace @arena/server test:coverage
scripts.validate: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test
